summary: Sync sent each request body as one Full<Bytes> frame, causing Windows IoSlice construction to panic when its length exceeded u32::MAX. The fix introduces ChunkedBody with zero-copy frames capped at 4 MiB and an exact size hint. Blocked: the added test, sync::tests::http_body_never_yields_a_frame_larger_than_the_frame_limit (package turso, feature sync), directly instantiates the newly introduced ChunkedBody. Reverting its introduction makes the unchanged test fail to compile; retaining it while restoring the worker's Full<Bytes> usage leaves the tested implementation fixed. Removing the frame cap would invent parent code. No detecting test compatible with a valid verbatim reversal was established. No builds or tests were run.
